The vulnerable code is present (the old check `ijk->i > 1 || ijk->j > 1 || ijk->k > 1` is there). So the target is vulnerable. But my PoC didn't crash. 

Let me reconsider. Maybe the issue is that `_isBaseCellPentagon(121)` or the base cell 121 isn't valid, or the flow doesn't reach `_getBaseCellNeighbor`. Let me check: is base cell 121 a valid base cell? NUM_BASE_CELLS = 122, so 121 is valid (0-121).

Wait, but maybe the issue is that `_unitIjkToDigit` doesn't return 7 for the normalized ijk. Let me re-examine. Actually, let me reconsider whether the integer overflow actually happens as I simulated. The issue is that in C, signed integer overflow is undefined behavior, and with ASAN/UBSAN it might behave differently, or the compiler might optimize differently.

Actually, let me reconsider the whole approach. Maybe the crash requires a different input. Let me look at the OSS-Fuzz issue more carefully. The issue is 42515760. Let me search for the actual test case / crash input.

Actually, let me reconsider. The fix commit's test case `invalid_negativeIj` uses `index = 0x200f202020202020` and `ij = {.i = -14671840, .j = -2147483648}`. This is likely derived from the actual OSS-Fuzz crash input. But maybe the fuzzer input needs `index2` and `mode` set to specific values too, or the crash happens in a different call.

Wait, actually — let me reconsider. The fuzzer calls `localIjToCell(args->index, &ij, 0, &out)` where `ij = {args->i, args->j}`. This is the FIRST `localIjToCell` call (line 67). If this crashes, great. But maybe the crash happens in a later call.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20) # Due to dependency on CMP0115

# Do not try to append extensions to source files
cmake_policy(SET CMP0115 NEW)

file(READ VERSION H3_VERSION LIMIT_COUNT 1)
# Clean any newlines
string(REPLACE "\n" "" H3_VERSION "${H3_VERSION}")
# Remove any trailing qualifier
string(REGEX REPLACE "-.*$" "" H3_VERSION "${H3_VERSION}")

project(h3 LANGUAGES C VERSION ${H3_VERSION})

set(H3_PREFIX "" CACHE STRING "Prefix for exported symbols")
set(H3_ALLOC_PREFIX "" CACHE STRING "Prefix for allocation functions")

# Needed due to CMP0042
set(CMAKE_MACOSX_RPATH 1)
# YCM needs compilation database
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake")

# Some misc apps do not work with shared libraries on Windows
# because they require access to internal H3 functions. Build these
# using either static libraries or an option to expose all
# function symbols.
if(NOT (WIN32 AND BUILD_SHARED_LIBS))
    set(ENABLE_REQUIRES_ALL_SYMBOLS ON)
else()
    set(ENABLE_REQUIRES_ALL_SYMBOLS OFF)
endif()

option(ENABLE_COVERAGE "Enable compiling tests with coverage." ON)
option(BUILD_BENCHMARKS "Build benchmarking applications." ON)
option(BUILD_FUZZERS "Build fuzzer applications (for use with afl)." ON)
